# Configuration reference

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_config_reference.py; do not edit by hand -->

A campaign is configured by one YAML file. Only `objective` is required.
Unknown keys are an error. Paths in the file are relative to the file.
`aurora init` writes a commented starter file.

## Top level

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `objective` | str | **required** | The open-ended research objective, in plain language. |
| `campaign_id` | str | `""` | Name of the campaign directory. Empty: derived from the objective and the time. |
| `mock_mode` | bool | `false` | Run offline with scripted mock models and tools: no API key, no Claude Code, no Docker. The mock models replay a scripted materials-science study whatever the objective; use it to try the pipeline and in tests. |
| `inputs` | list[str] | `[]` | Files or directories the agents should work with (data, code, papers). They are copied to inputs/ in the agents' working directory (/app/inputs in the container). |
| `skills_dirs` | list[str] | `[]` | Directories of Claude Code skills (<name>/SKILL.md) written by you; every agent session can use them, next to the skills in the skill library. |
| `skip_phases` | list[str] | `[]` | Phases to skip, any of ['ideation', 'screening', 'planning', 'preflight', 'research', 'analysis', 'writing']. |
| `api_base_url` | str | `"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"` | OpenRouter-compatible endpoint used by all agents. |
| `api_key` | str | `""` | API key for api_base_url. Empty: OPENROUTER_API_KEY from the environment or .env. |
| `providers` | list[ProviderConfig] | `[]` | Extra providers for models outside OpenRouter (advanced). |

## `skills`

How the skill library grows (paper: "Skill invocation", appendix "Domain-Specific Skills").

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skills.distill` | bool | `true` | Self-distillation: after each phase and research job, propose new skills (or revisions) from procedures that worked and failures that were diagnosed. |
| `skills.from_feedback` | bool | `true` | Turn the researcher's reusable corrections and conventions into skills on their first occurrence. |
| `skills.auto_accept` | bool | `false` | Add proposed skills to the library at once. Off: each one waits for you in the web console (add to the library, to this project only, or dismiss). |

## `uploads`

Files researchers upload in the web console.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uploads.max_file_gb` | float | `20` | Largest file that can be uploaded (GB). |
| `uploads.max_project_gb` | float | `200` | Most a project's uploaded files may take in all (GB). |

## `voice`

Speaking in the web console (the brainstorm's microphone).

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `voice.live` | `fast` \| `accurate` \| `off` | `"fast"` | Words shown while you speak. 'fast': a small whisper model (AURORA_WHISPER_LIVE), a few times a second; 'accurate': the main model (AURORA_WHISPER), about once a second; 'off': only when you stop. What is sent is always recognised again by the main model. |
| `voice.hearing` | `model` \| `local` | `"model"` | How what you say is recognised. 'model': hearing_model through api_base_url (the same key; told the names and terms of your projects, papers and digest; about a hundredth of a cent a message), falling back to whisper; 'local': only the whisper command in AURORA_WHISPER, nothing leaves the machine. A recording without speech is never sent. |
| `voice.hearing_model` | str | `"qwen/qwen3.8-omni-flash"` | A model that listens, to recognise speech (google/gemini-3.8-flash also hears well). |
| `voice.speech` | `model` \| `browser` | `"model"` | Answers read aloud by 'model': speech_model through api_base_url (the same key; a few tenths of a cent an answer), or by 'browser': the browser's own voice (free, mechanical). A speech service in AURORA_TTS_BASE_URL is used instead of either when set. |
| `voice.speech_model` | str | `"openai/gpt-audio-mini"` | A model that talks, to read answers aloud. |
| `voice.speech_voice` | str | `"alloy"` | Its voice (alloy, ash, ballad, coral, echo, sage, shimmer, verse, ...). |

## `models`

Which model plays each role.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `models.agent` | str | `"anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5"` | Model of the Claude Code sessions that run screening, planning, research, analysis and writing, unless a phase sets its own below. |
| `models.screening` | str | `""` | Model of the screening agent. Empty: models.agent. |
| `models.planning` | str | `""` | Model of the planning agent. Empty: models.agent. |
| `models.preflight` | str | `""` | Model of the pre-flight agent. Empty: models.agent. |
| `models.research` | str | `""` | Model of the research agent. Empty: models.agent. |
| `models.analysis` | str | `""` | Model of the analysis agent. Empty: models.agent. |
| `models.writing` | str | `""` | Model of the writing agent. Empty: models.agent. |
| `models.ideation_seats` | list[str] | `["anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5", "openai/gpt-5.6-sol", "google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview"]` | One model per ideation seat. Heterogeneous models give more diverse ideas. |
| `models.ideation_chair` | str | `"moonshotai/kimi-k3"` | Model of the ideation chair, who decides the research direction. Pick a family not among the seats so it judges the ideas neutrally. |
| `models.auditor` | str | `"anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5"` | Model of the milestone auditor that reviews each phase's output. |
| `models.skills` | str | `""` | Model that decides what to keep as skills: it drafts skills from the agents' runs and from your corrections. Empty: models.auditor. |
| `models.supervisor` | str | `"anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5"` | Model of the live auditor (supervisor) that watches the research agent. |
| `models.frontdesk` | str | `"anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5"` | Model of the front desk agent that talks with the human. |
| `models.brainstorm` | str | `""` | Model of the brainstorm agents (Skeptic, Methods, Librarian). Empty: models.frontdesk. |
| `models.review` | str | `"anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5"` | Model that maps a field and reads papers closely (zoom out, zoom in): scoping, searching the web for papers, adjudicating screening, and every judgement of the map. A strong model matters here. |
| `models.memory` | str | `"anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5"` | Model of the shared notebook: it takes the claims out of what you save, tells whether two claims say the same thing (or the opposite), and ranks them for what you are doing. |
| `models.embedding` | str | `"openai/text-embedding-3-large"` | Embedding model of the shared notebook (an OpenRouter model): finds claims that may say the same thing, across languages, and what bears on what you are reading. |
| `models.review_screen` | list[str] | `["anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5", "google/gemini-3.5-flash-lite"]` | Two models that screen candidate papers independently (title and abstract), and read them for their cards. Different families make the two screenings independent. |

## `ideation`

Multi-agent ideation: several models propose directions and a chair decides.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ideation.mode` | `roundtable` \| `independent` | `"roundtable"` | 'roundtable': the seats present their ideas and discuss them in a group meeting before the chair decides. 'independent': each seat proposes an idea on its own and the chair picks one, without discussion (cheaper). |
| `ideation.seats` | list[SeatConfig] | `[]` | Named seats with their own prompts. Empty: one seat per models.ideation_seats. |
| `ideation.rounds_per_item` | int | `2` | Roundtable mode: remark/response exchanges per presentation. |
| `ideation.web_search` | bool | `true` | Let seats search the literature and the web while preparing and answering (OpenRouter web plugin, a small extra cost per call; seat models must be OpenRouter models). Turn it off when evaluating ideation on known problems, so ideas cannot simply be looked up. |
| `ideation.live` | bool | `false` | Brainstorm with the researcher: the round table runs live in the project's brainstorm space, its seats' ideas and questions become cards there, and the researcher can speak in the meeting (the chair gives them the floor before the next turn). Web console only. |
| `ideation.develop_objective` | bool | `false` | The objective is the researcher's own idea: the seats develop it into its strongest version instead of proposing other directions (a round table started from a brainstorm idea). |
| `ideation.source_card` | str | `""` | The brainstorm idea the experiment starts from: in a live meeting, each new version the researcher writes of it is heard before the next turn; when the run ends, what it found goes back onto the idea. |
| `ideation.chair_prompt` | str | `""` | System prompt of the chair. Empty: built-in. |
| `ideation.seat_prompt` | str | `""` | System prompt of the seats. Empty: built-in. '{seat_id}' is replaced by the seat ID. |

## `literature`

Real literature: agents search the scholarly indexes and every reference they cite is checked.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `literature.enabled` | bool | `true` | Search OpenAlex, arXiv, Crossref and Semantic Scholar for the agents (ideation seats choose their own queries; screening looks for the closest prior work), check every reference they cite, and keep the papers in the project's literature. Free; needs network access from the server. Turn it off when evaluating ideation on known problems. |
| `literature.add_found` | `all` \| `cited` \| `none` | `"cited"` | Papers the agents find: 'all' puts every paper a search finds into the project's literature; 'cited' only the papers an agent cites (the rest wait in their search); 'none' nothing by itself, you add papers from the searches. A paper that cannot be found in any index is never added. |
| `literature.queries_per_turn` | int | `3` | Ideation: searches a seat may run before it presents or answers remarks (0: none). |
| `literature.results_per_query` | int | `6` | Papers shown to the agent per search. |
| `literature.screening_search` | bool | `true` | Screening judges novelty against the closest prior work found in the indexes. |

## `agent`

Limits of the Claude Code sessions that do the work.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agent.research_max_turns` | int | `200` | Turn limit of one research session. |
| `agent.research_timeout_minutes` | float | `60` | Time limit of one research job. |
| `agent.phase_max_turns` | int | `30` | Turn limit of the screening, planning, analysis and writing sessions. |
| `agent.preflight_timeout_minutes` | float | `20` | Time limit of the pre-flight checks of a plan (all its jobs). |
| `agent.preflight_max_revisions` | int | `2` | How often planning revises the plan when pre-flight finds problems, before you decide. |
| `agent.max_parallel_jobs` | int | `1` | Research jobs that may run at the same time, each with its own agent, when the plan's dependencies allow it. They share the container (CPUs, memory, /app). |
| `agent.max_research_iterations` | int | `10` | Maximum research jobs executed in one research cycle. |
| `agent.max_followup_cycles` | int | `2` | How often analysis may send the campaign back for more research. |

## `sandbox`

Where the agents' commands run.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sandbox.docker` | bool | `true` | Run every command in one Docker container per campaign. Without Docker the agents can only read and edit files in the workspace (see allow_host_bash). |
| `sandbox.image` | str | `"python:3.11-slim"` | Docker image of the campaign container. |
| `sandbox.cpus` | float | `4.0` | CPU limit of the container. |
| `sandbox.memory_mb` | int | `8192` | Memory limit of the container in MB. |
| `sandbox.network` | bool | `true` | Allow internet access from the container. |
| `sandbox.agent_in_container` | bool | `false` | Experimental: run research agents inside the container, with full freedom there. The API key stays in a small proxy container; the campaign container gets a random token. Needs mount_workspace and an image with glibc (not Alpine). |
| `sandbox.mount_workspace` | bool | `true` | Mount <campaign>/workspace as the container's /app, so the agents' files are on the host as they are written (no copying). Turn off if Docker runs on another machine. |
| `sandbox.allow_host_bash` | bool | `false` | With docker: false, let agents run shell commands directly on this machine. Only for trusted tasks on a disposable machine. |
| `sandbox.tests_dir` | str | `""` | Optional acceptance tests (a directory with test.sh or pytest files) run in the container after each research job; a job counts as done when they pass. |

## `audit`

The two auditors (paper: "Just-in-time auditing").

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `audit.milestone` | bool | `true` | Review every phase hand-off. Verdicts: pass, reject (the phase revises its output) or escalate (a human gate). |
| `audit.milestone_max_retries` | int | `2` | Revisions a rejected phase gets before the gate escalates to the human. |
| `audit.live` | bool | `true` | Run the live auditor (supervisor) next to the research agent. It can let the agent continue, advise it, interrupt it, or escalate to the human. |

## `human`

How the campaign involves the human.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `human.autonomy` | `autonomous` \| `supervised` | `"supervised"` | supervised: escalations wait for a human decision. autonomous: they are recorded and the campaign continues. |
| `human.frontdesk` | bool | `true` | Run the front desk agent, which answers questions about the running campaign and relays instructions to the research agent (duplex interaction). |
| `human.gate_timeout_minutes` | float | `60` | How long a human gate waits before taking on_timeout. |
| `human.on_timeout` | `continue` \| `stop` | `"continue"` | What a human gate does when nobody answers in time. |
| `human.approve_termination` | bool | `false` | Ask the human before the campaign finishes. |

## `budget`

Hard limits; the campaign stops when one is reached.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `budget.max_hours` | float | `24` | Wall-clock limit of the whole campaign. |
| `budget.max_cost_usd` | float | None | `null` | Limit on the API cost reported by the agent sessions. None: no limit. |
| `budget.estimate_usd` | list[float] | None | `null` | What the run was estimated to cost, [low, high] (set by the console). The run notifies when it costs more than the upper end, and again at twice it. |
| `budget.estimate_hours` | list[float] | None | `null` | What the run was estimated to take, [low, high] hours (set by the console). |

## `notifications`

Messages to you when something needs you or a run ends, so you need not watch the console.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `notifications.console_url` | str | `""` | The web console's address as you open it (e.g. http://localhost:8100); notifications link to the experiment there. Empty: the address it serves on. |
| `notifications.channels` | list[NotifyChannel] | `[]` |  |
| `notifications.budget_warning_at` | float | `0.8` | Share of an experiment's cost or time budget at which budget_warning is sent. |
| `notifications.quiet_start` | str | `""` | Quiet hours from (HH:MM, the server's time); empty: none. Messages are held and sent together when they end. |
| `notifications.quiet_end` | str | `""` | Quiet hours until (HH:MM). |
| `notifications.quiet_except` | list[str] | `[]` | Kinds sent even in quiet hours (e.g. decision_needed). |
| `notifications.progress_every_hours` | float | `3` | While an experiment runs, how it is getting on, every this many hours (when something happened); 0: never. Goes to your linked chat apps, and to channels that take `progress`. |
| `notifications.progress_phases` | bool | `true` | Also a word when an experiment enters a new phase (planning, research, analysis, writing). |
| `notifications.action_links` | bool | `true` | Put "Approve" and "Stop" links into decision messages (they open a confirmation page; the console address must be set). |

## `compute`

Compute beyond the experiment's container: a SLURM cluster or a GPU machine over SSH.

## `compute.slurm`

Research agents submit heavy work (training, long runs) as SLURM jobs.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `compute.slurm.enabled` | bool | `false` | Let research agents submit cluster jobs. |
| `compute.slurm.submit_via` | list[str] | `[]` | Command prefix that reaches the SLURM tools, e.g. [ssh, login-node]. Empty: sbatch/squeue/scancel run on this machine. |
| `compute.slurm.partition` | str | `""` | Partition jobs go to unless the agent picks another. |
| `compute.slurm.partitions` | list[str] | `[]` | Other partitions the agent may pick. |
| `compute.slurm.account` | str | `""` | --account, if the cluster needs one. |
| `compute.slurm.qos` | str | `""` | --qos, if the cluster needs one. |
| `compute.slurm.job_name_prefix` | str | `"aurora"` | Start of every job name (some clusters want your user name first, e.g. alice-aurora). |
| `compute.slurm.max_gpus_per_job` | int | `8` | Most GPUs one job may ask for. |
| `compute.slurm.max_jobs` | int | `4` | Jobs of one experiment queued or running at once. |
| `compute.slurm.cpus_per_gpu` | int | `8` | CPUs a job gets per GPU (at least this many). |
| `compute.slurm.mem_per_gpu_gb` | int | `64` | Memory a job gets per GPU (GB). |
| `compute.slurm.default_time` | str | `"04:00:00"` | Time limit of a job that names none. |
| `compute.slurm.max_time` | str | `"24:00:00"` | Longest time limit a job may ask for. |
| `compute.slurm.max_gpu_hours` | float | None | `null` | GPU hours one experiment may use in all (counted as jobs run). None: no limit. |
| `compute.slurm.image_dir` | str | `""` | Where the container image is saved for the nodes (squashfs). Must be on shared storage. Empty: AURORA_HOME/compute/images. |
| `compute.slurm.extra_args` | list[str] | `[]` | More #SBATCH options, e.g. ['--exclude=node3']. |
| `compute.slurm.cancel_on_finish` | bool | `true` | Cancel an experiment's jobs still queued or running when it ends. |
| `compute.slurm.check_in_minutes` | list[float] | `[10, 10, 10, 20, 30, 45, 60]` | An agent waiting for its jobs (aurora job await) is shown their state after these intervals, one after the other, the last repeating; it is woken at once when they end. |

## `compute.ssh`

Research agents run heavy work on a GPU machine reached over SSH (no scheduler there).

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `compute.ssh.enabled` | bool | `false` | Let research agents run jobs on a GPU machine over SSH. |
| `compute.ssh.host` | str | `""` | The machine, as ssh reaches it: a Host from ~/.ssh/config or user@address. |
| `compute.ssh.ssh_options` | list[str] | `[]` | More ssh options, e.g. ['-p', '2222', '-i', '~/.ssh/gpu_key']. |
| `compute.ssh.remote_dir` | str | `"aurora-jobs"` | Where experiments' workspaces are kept on the machine (relative: in the home directory). |
| `compute.ssh.docker` | bool | `true` | Run jobs in Docker on the machine (needs Docker with GPU support there). |
| `compute.ssh.image` | str | `""` | Image jobs run in. Empty: the experiment's own image (sent over with docker save when the machine does not have it). |
| `compute.ssh.setup` | str | `""` | Shell commands run before every job, e.g. 'source ~/miniconda3/bin/activate ml'. |
| `compute.ssh.gpus` | list[int] | `[]` | GPUs jobs may use (nvidia-smi indices). Empty: all of them. |
| `compute.ssh.busy_memory_mb` | int | `2000` | A GPU using more memory than this is taken to be busy (someone else's work). |
| `compute.ssh.sync_exclude` | list[str] | `[".git", "__pycache__", ".ipynb_checkpoints"]` | Workspace paths not copied either way (rsync patterns). |
| `compute.ssh.job_name_prefix` | str | `"aurora"` | Start of every job's name (and container name). |
| `compute.ssh.max_gpus_per_job` | int | `8` | Most GPUs one job may ask for. |
| `compute.ssh.max_jobs` | int | `4` | Jobs of one experiment waiting or running at once. |
| `compute.ssh.cpus_per_gpu` | int | `8` | CPUs a job gets per GPU (Docker only). |
| `compute.ssh.mem_per_gpu_gb` | int | `64` | Memory a job gets per GPU (GB, Docker only). |
| `compute.ssh.default_time` | str | `"04:00:00"` | Time limit of a job that names none. |
| `compute.ssh.max_time` | str | `"24:00:00"` | Longest time limit a job may ask for. |
| `compute.ssh.max_gpu_hours` | float | None | `null` | GPU hours one experiment may use in all. None: no limit. |
| `compute.ssh.cancel_on_finish` | bool | `true` | Stop an experiment's jobs still waiting or running when it ends. |
| `compute.ssh.check_in_minutes` | list[float] | `[10, 10, 10, 20, 30, 45, 60]` | As compute.slurm.check_in_minutes. |

## `workspace`

Where the campaign writes its files.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace.root` | str | `"./workspace"` | Directory under which the campaign directory <root>/<campaign_id> is created. |

## `prompts`

System prompts of the phase agents. Override one to change how a phase works.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompts.screening` | str | *(long text, see `aurora init` or the source)* | Screening: scores the proposal for novelty, feasibility and significance. |
| `prompts.planning` | str | *(long text, see `aurora init` or the source)* | Planning: turns the proposal into jobs. |
| `prompts.preflight` | str | *(long text, see `aurora init` or the source)* | Pre-flight: checks prerequisites and smoke-runs each job before research. |
| `prompts.research` | str | *(long text, see `aurora init` or the source)* | Research: executes the jobs. |
| `prompts.analysis` | str | *(long text, see `aurora init` or the source)* | Analysis: checks the results and decides whether more research is needed. |
| `prompts.writing` | str | *(long text, see `aurora init` or the source)* | Writing: produces the final report. |
